_comment: CapacitorHttp is intentionally DISABLED (it ships inside @capacitor/core, no install needed). Reachability for /api/* is solved with CORS on our own serverless functions instead — see api/_cors.js. If a /api/* call still fails on a real device, add "plugins": { "CapacitorHttp": { "enabled": true } } here, run `npm run build:ios`, and then RE-TEST Supabase sign-in: the plugin patches global fetch/XHR, so it can change how the auth client behaves.
